title: Practice: Rear Roundhouse Kick
source: Practice Mode tutorial. Words from the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Rear Roundhouse Kick: cues, mistakes, next); the same video serves the Kickboxing and MMA entries and the Rear Roundhouse Kick lessons of the Kickboxing and Muay Thai paths. Thai: te tat (เตะตัด), the roundhouse. Footage: the owner's clip 24 (ring, 2026-11-03), raw-footage/practice/p24.mp4, two shots joined in InShot (the join at 5.63 s is too soft for scene detection; found by the body jumping across the frame): three kicks facing the camera (1.2, 3.95 and 4.95 s), one wider (6.8 s).

props.hookSub: Rear roundhouse kick. Te tat. 20 seconds.

cues.label: HIPS
cues.say: Coach: "The hip turns all the way over. The leg just comes along for the ride."

cues.label: SHIN
cues.say: Coach: "Contact is the shin, not the foot. Toes pointed, shin through the target."

cues.label: ARM
cues.say: Coach: "The same-side arm swings down and back. That's the counterweight that turns the hip."

watch.label: PIVOT
watch.say: Coach: "If the base foot doesn't turn, the hip can't. Heel toward the target."

drill.cue: Turn the hip all the way
